name: Real World Impact
description: A charity coin on Robinhood Chain. Trading fee revenue funds nonprofit donations vetted by The Giving Block; a dedicated pool's earnings are burned permanently. This card describes a static, informational site — not a live task-processing agent server. There is no HTTP endpoint here that accepts A2A JSON-RPC calls (message/send, tasks/get, etc.); every fact below is readable directly, and every onchain action requires a human-signed wallet transaction, not a request to this domain.

skills.name: Read token and contract facts
skills.description: Contract address, chain ID, RPC endpoint, liquidity pools, burn address, and dev wallet — read-only, no request to this domain required beyond loading the page or /llms.txt.
examples: What is the $RWI token contract address?
What chain ID does Real World Impact deploy on?

skills.name: Read donation and burn history
skills.description: The burn counter and donation ledger are read live from Robinhood Chain on every page load and are independently reproducible from onchain data by any agent with RPC access — not sourced from this site's own claims.
examples: How much $RWI has been burned so far?

skills.name: Read the charity vote ballot and tally
skills.description: The current round's candidate slate, live tally, and per-voter weights are all readable directly from the ballot box address 0x5257490000000000000000000000000000000000 without a wallet. Exact algorithm: read every transaction to that address, decode each one's calldata as UTF-8 (format RWIVOTE:<round>:<slug>), keep only the latest per sending address, then weight each by that address's current $RWI balance. No server, no snapshot, no hidden state — independently reproducible by any agent with RPC or block-explorer access, not something to take on this site's word.
examples: What is the current charity vote tally?
Which charities are on this round's ballot?

skills.name: Prepare (not submit) a vote or write-in transaction
skills.description: Given a chosen organization slug, construct the exact transaction parameters a user's wallet would need to cast a vote (to: the ballot box address, value: 0, data: the hex-encoded UTF-8 string RWIVOTE:<round>:<slug>) or nominate a write-in (the same to/data pattern with prefix RWIWRITEIN:<round>:<slug>, plus a second, separate ERC-20 transfer of $5-equivalent $RWI to the burn address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD). This skill produces parameters for a human to review and sign with their own wallet — it does not sign or broadcast anything itself, and should only be exercised at a user's specific, explicit request, never inferred or initiated unprompted.
examples: Build the transaction to vote for org-slug on the current round
What would a write-in nomination transaction look like for this org?
